title: Sentrux Rust binary scores codebase architecture for agent sessions
summary: Sentrux is a pure-Rust architectural sensor that scans repo structure and dependencies into a live treemap and folds five root-cause metrics into one quality score so agents start from a map instead of blind grep.
question_it_answers: How can an agent keep a live architecture map between sessions without re-explaining the codebase?

claims.text: Sentrux watches a codebase as a live treemap and compresses structure and dependency risk into one continuous quality score.
claims.evidence: sentrux is a real-time architectural sensor, it watches your codebase as a live treemap and turns file structure and dependencies into one continuous quality score.
claims.subject: agent-memory-knowledge

claims.text: Language support lives in plugin.toml and tags.scm files so adding a language needs no Rust changes.
claims.evidence: all 52 languages live in plugin.toml and tags.scm query files, so a new language needs zero rust code.
claims.subject: agent-memory-knowledge
